The '''Blinged-out clone trooper''' were specialized [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].

Their armor, as indicated by the name, was given metallic gold patterns and also was lined with small amounts of [[Diamond/Legends|diamonds]]. The emblem for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was located on the chest. Owing to the gold-colored nature of the armor, blinged-out clone troopers also carried a special gold-colored rifle.

==Behind the scenes==
The blinged-out clone troopers were a special uniform given out during the Halloween Trick or Treats event in [[2010]], and later were a purchasable uniform in [[2011]].
